neighbours.label: the participle of 'be' in a perfect passive (has been, have been, a été) before the main verb
fire: La nouvelle loi a été votée samedi par les députés.
The final at Leeds on Sunday has been cancelled.
Sadly, we have been removed from the competition.
La militante a été agressée près de chez elle.
The ones having been chosen may receive the award.
Their flight has been delayed by the snow.
Le pont a été fermé pendant trois jours.
All of the players have been told about the change.
quiet: La nouvelle loi est très longue selon les députés.
The final at Leeds on Sunday starts at noon.
Sadly, we have a problem with the competition.
La militante habite près de chez elle.
The ones arriving early may receive the award.
Their flight leaves in the snow.
Le pont est fermé pendant trois jours.
All of the players know about the change.
